analysis_population: inner_train subjects plus inner_val discovery subjects only
backbone: canonical frozen V3 EEGNet final-refit checkpoint
conditional_diagnostic_router_training: allowed only after development oracle BA gain >= 0.01

intervention.P_movement: absolute L2 norm from the native successor P coordinates at alpha=1
intervention.argmax_tie: scores within 1e-8 tie; choose alpha closest to 1, then smaller alpha; direction ties use lower fold-local index
intervention.downstream_C: full native successor complement preserved for every intervention
intervention.margin: true_class logit minus largest non-true logit
intervention.native_predicted_probability: probability assigned to native baseline argmax under each alpha
intervention.successor_C_preservation_tolerance: absolute float32 re-projection error < max(1e-5, 64*float32_eps*max(1, max_abs(y_tilde), max_abs(mu_d), max_abs(c_d_native))); alpha=1 logit identity remains fixed at 1e-5

oracles.independent_direction_upper_bound: choose each direction alpha independently from its one-direction response curve, then apply all selected alphas jointly; LOOSE_UPPER_BOUND_NOT_DEPLOYABLE
oracles.one_direction: per trial choose best direction and alpha by true-class margin; all others native

random_alpha_control.rule: per trial draw one structured C direction and one alpha uniformly; no outcome-dependent selection

oracles.random_direction_oracle: one-direction oracle over the fold's V3-prelocked random complement basis draw 0; same rank as C basis
oracles.top3: visit the three prelocked inner_train utility-ranked directions in descending rank order; at each step choose a trial-specific alpha by true-class margin conditional on earlier steps; at most one change per direction
oracles.utility_rank: descending absolute V3 U_P mean computed only from inner_train subject rows; ties by direction index

reused_cells.top3_ranking_rule: descending absolute inner_train subject-equal U_P mean, ties by fold-local direction index

feature_inputs: native P/C and transfer norm descriptors
router.model: StandardScaler plus multinomial LogisticRegression C=1, class_weight=balanced, max_iter=500
router.target: alpha class for the prelocked top-1 inner_train utility direction
router.training_validation: 5-fold GroupKFold by biological subject inside inner_train; final fit on all inner_train

statistics.NATIVE_STRENGTH_NEAR_OPTIMAL: all four tasks satisfy LOW_ACTIONABILITY_HEADROOM and more than half of utility-positive trial optima lie in alpha {0.75,1,1.25}
statistics.TRIAL_CONDITIONAL_ACTIONABILITY: at least one task passes the 1 pp oracle gate and at least half of utility-positive direction profiles meet the locked two-sided trial-conditional rule
statistics.UTILITY_NONMONOTONIC: at least half of utility-positive subject-session-direction rows have local margin slope <=0, or at least half of direction profiles are PEAK_NEAR_NATIVE or NONMONOTONIC
statistics.direction_trial_conditional: both P(alpha*<1) and P(alpha*>1) are at least 0.10 for a direction
statistics.paired_bootstrap_delta: resample matched biological subjects for both variants; 20,000 draws
statistics.peak_near_native: group mean margin argmax in {0.75,1,1.25} and paired subject-bootstrap lower CI exceeds both alpha=0 and alpha=2
statistics.pooling: trial metrics within subject-session; average sessions within biological subject; average folds within subject; equal biological-subject weighting
statistics.router_headroom_recovery_denominator: the larger of the same task's discovery ORACLE_1DIR and ORACLE_TOP3 BA gains over baseline
statistics.router_task_gate: for each task trigger if pooled discovery ORACLE_1DIR or ORACLE_TOP3 BA gain is at least 0.01
statistics.router_trigger: run only if discovery ORACLE_1DIR or ORACLE_TOP3 BA gain is at least 0.01

amendment.reason: WBCIC_MI fold0 produced the same 3.0517578125e-05 float32 complement re-projection error on GPU and CPU while alpha=1 logit identity stayed below 4e-07. The fixed absolute complement check conflated scale-dependent float32 roundoff with prediction identity.
amendment.scope: Only the numerical acceptance check for successor-C re-projection changed. EEGNet, weights, split roles, intervention, alpha grid, utility ranking, oracles, router gate, metrics, and bootstrap did not change.
amendment.preservation_rule: absolute float32 re-projection error < max(1e-5, 64*float32_eps*max(1, max_abs(y_tilde), max_abs(mu_d), max_abs(c_d_native))); alpha=1 logit identity remains fixed at 1e-5
amendment.identity_rule: Unchanged: alpha=1 logit max absolute error < 1e-5 and exact prediction identity.
amendment.prior_completed_cells: 15 cells completed under the stricter absolute 1e-5 complement check; retain only after validating their recorded output hashes, then re-attest markers to this lock without changing curve or metric files.
amendment.failed_attempt_policy: The incomplete WBCIC_MI fold0 outputs from the parent lock are not used; all five WBCIC folds run under this amendment.
